preregistration.name: LHS 1140 b Milestone 11 frozen-detector new-target transfer
preregistration.scientific_target: An intermittent narrowband signal coherent under the selected LHS 1140 b motion hypothesis; the signal is not assumed to originate on the planet or to be aimed at Earth
preregistration.selection_rule: Use the complete public 2017-01-21 Green Bank Telescope L-band ABACAD cadence for LHS 1140: three LHS 1140 ON scans interleaved with three different OFF positions. Search the same five predeclared 1 MHz planet-frame intervals used in Milestone 10 so that target, telescope, date, cadence, and source payload change while detector settings and frequency coverage remain fixed.
preregistration.survey_scope: New target, telescope, observing date, scan cadence, and source filterbank payload relative to Milestones 5-10. Frequency intervals are intentionally held identical to Milestone 10 for a controlled transfer test.
preregistration.method_note: The Milestone 8-10 v0.4.0 recurrence statistic, S/N floor, moving per-epoch RFI mask, spectral widths, candidate clustering, family flags, orbital bank, and completeness procedure are copied without adjustment. Only target/observatory/orbit metadata, scan selection, labels, and random seeds differ.
preregistration.prior_data_contact: Public archive catalogue records and the six SIGPROC headers were inspected to verify identity, completeness, cadence, resolution, and coverage. No spectral payload from any selected search interval was extracted or inspected before this preregistration.
preregistration.control_cadence_note: Each ON scan and each OFF scan has 16 integrations of 18.253611008 s. The equal-duration controls remove the ON/OFF sensitivity imbalance present in Milestone 10.
preregistration.observing_session_limit: All three ON scans occur within one 28-minute ABACAD session on 2017-01-21. They are recurrence opportunities within a cadence, not independent observing nights, so this milestone cannot test long-baseline recurrence.
preregistration.orbital_phase_convention: The archive composite solution supplies a transit midpoint but no uniquely defined periastron or argument of periastron. The working template therefore adopts a circular orbit, stores the transit midpoint in the phase-reference field, and uses omega=pi/2 so line-of-sight velocity is zero at inferior conjunction and increases immediately afterward. The frozen plus/minus 0.2-cycle phase bank remains in force.
preregistration.source_location_note: LHS 1140 b supplies a predicted motion template, not a proven source location. A surviving feature could originate elsewhere within the telescope response or be terrestrial, spaceborne, or instrumental interference.
preregistration.data_release: Breakthrough Listen Green Bank Telescope public L-band high-resolution filterbanks; cadence --114914

completeness.method: Real m11_1412p5 planet-frame noise vectors are independently circularly shifted by epoch; signals use time-averaged sinc-squared leakage and model acceleration within each integration.
completeness.ideal_snr_definition: Single-epoch S/N the same total signal power would produce as a stationary bin-centred one-channel tone.

interpretation_limits: This search covers 5 disjoint planet-frame bands totaling 5 MHz, not the full receiver band.
A null result constrains only signals present in at least two of the three epochs and represented by the orbital template bank.
The 1/3/5/9-channel boxcars approximate, but do not exactly match, every fractional-bin and acceleration-smeared line shape.
Completeness is measured for exact orbital-bank templates active in epochs 1 and 3; it is not yet marginalized over orbital-model error or every duty cycle.
When configured, the recurrence guard requires every claimed active epoch to exceed its stated single-epoch S/N floor.
The strong-single-epoch RFI mask and recurrence statistic were added after the first Milestone 7 diagnostic run; independent future bands are required for confirmation.
The per-epoch RFI mask follows each circularly shifted epoch in the empirical null and completeness trials.
Scramble p-values are empirical ranks with resolution 1/(N+1), not Gaussian sigma conversions.
